title: Rally UI component diagram
description: Drawing, input, sound and the name-entry keyboard: everything between the engine and the page's DOM.

components.name: Rally UI
components.responsibility: The browser-facing pieces the page wires together.

components.name: Renderer (render.ts)
components.responsibility: Draws the table, paddles, ball and trail on the canvas, at most 2 pixels per CSS pixel.

components.name: Input (input.ts)
components.responsibility: Keys, touch and the mouse as one Control per step.

components.name: Sound (sound.ts)
components.responsibility: Short synthesised blips for game events.

components.name: Name entry (entry.ts)
components.responsibility: Twelve underlined slots, a blinking cursor and an on-screen keyboard.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: The match rules and their types.

components.name: Name rules (src/name.ts)
components.responsibility: Which characters a name may hold.

relationships.description: Reads State and GameEvent to draw.
Produces a Control in table coordinates.
Plays GameEvents; faster balls click higher.
Accepts only name characters, up to NAME_MAX.
